WorkOrderShare.name: WorkOrderShare
WorkOrderShare.description: Represents a sharing entry on a work order.

AccessLevel.description: Level of access that the user or group has to the work order. The possible values are: Read Edit All (This value isn’t valid for create or update calls.) Set to an access level that is at least equal to the organization’s default work order access level.

ParentId.description: The work order associated with the sharing entry.

RowCause.description: Reason that this sharing entry exists. If you’re creating a sharing entry, the only permitted value is Manual. If no value is specified, the field defaults to Manual. All other RowCause values are read-only. After the sharing entry is created, this field can’t be edited. Valid values include: Manual—The User or Group has access because a user with “All” access manually shared the work order. Owner—The User is the owner of the work order. Rule—The User or Group has access via a work order sharing rule. GuestRule—The User or Group has access via a work order guest user sharing rule. LpuImplicit—The User has access to records owned by high-volume Experience Cloud site users via a share group.

UserOrGroupId.description: (Read Only) ID of the user or group that has access to the work order.

WorkOrderShare.accessRules: Work orders or Field Service must be enabled in your organization. External users can’t access this object.
